title: Stress-testing the Local Learning Coefficient as a phase-transition detector on hand-built degenerate losses

original_idea.body:
# Stress-testing the LLC Estimator

Known-LLC toy models; measure SGLD estimator bias/variance vs ground truth, then apply to grokking.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: calibrating an alignment-proposed structure detector, but the safety-outcome link is indirect.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: SGLD-based LLC estimation and SLT ground-truth math require solid ML/theory; intermediate.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused estimator bias/variance calibration; hyperparameter sweep plus grokking application.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Neglected independent calibration of an alignment statistic, open tooling, strong external value.

low_compute.reasoning: Small models, single GPU; SGLD chains add cost.

novelty.reasoning: LLC estimation is studied but outsider bias/variance calibration on ground-truth toys may be partially open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: LLC estimation exists; independent calibration on analytic toys may be open.
